days.file: Giotto di Bondone - No. 25 Scenes from the Life of Christ - 9. Raising of Lazarus - WGA09204.jpg
days.title: The Raising of Lazarus (Scenes from the Life of Christ)
days.alt: Jesus, in red with a halo, speaks at the tomb of Lazarus while a woman in white kneels at His feet and mourners crowd behind.
days.look: Look again at the woman bowed low at Jesus’s feet, close enough to touch Him. What tears are you afraid to let Him see?
days.license: Artist died 1337; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain, Web Gallery of Art)

days.file: Vincent van Gogh - The Good Samaritan, 1890 - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Good Samaritan (after Delacroix)
days.alt: The Samaritan lifts the wounded traveller onto his horse in a swirling blue and gold landscape.
days.look: Look again at the Samaritan’s arms, taking the whole weight of the wounded man. Where do you most need to be carried right now?
days.license: Artist died 1890; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain, Google Art Project)

days.file: Rembrandt Harmensz. van Rijn - The Raising of Lazarus - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Raising of Lazarus
days.alt: Jesus stands at the mouth of the tomb with His hand raised, while Lazarus sits up in his burial cloths and onlookers lean in from the left.
days.look: Look again at Jesus’s raised hand and at the onlookers leaning in. When he asks you, “Do you believe this?”, what do you want to answer?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain, Google Art Project)

days.file: Rogier van der Weyden, Netherlandish (active Tournai and Brussels) - The Crucifixion, with the Virgin and Saint John the Evangelist Mourning - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: Christ on the Cross with Mary and Saint John the Evangelist (left panel)
days.alt: Mary in a blue mantle sinks into John’s arms at the foot of the cross, John’s hand holding her.
days.look: Look again at John’s arm around Mary. Who has been placed beside you to hold you up?
days.license: Artist died 1464; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain, Google Art Project)

days.file: Benozzo Gozzoli - Death of St Monica (scene 13, south wall) - WGA10306.jpg
days.title: The Death of St Monica
days.alt: Monica lies on her deathbed among praying women and friars, while Augustine, in a black habit and halo, reads prayers beside her.
days.look: Look again at the mourners gathered round Monica. Whom do you want to remember at the altar of the Lord?
days.license: Artist died 1497; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain, Web Gallery of Art)

days.file: Duccio di Buoninsegna - The Three Marys at the Tomb - WGA06817.jpg
days.title: The Three Marys at the Tomb (Maestà)
days.alt: An angel sits at the open tomb and speaks to the three women who came to it in sorrow.
days.look: Look again at the angel’s raised hand and the women who came to grieve. What hope would it take for you to stay and listen?
days.license: Artist died c. 1318; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain, Web Gallery of Art)

days.file: The Virgin of Tenderness - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Virgin of Tenderness
days.alt: Mary presses her cheek to the Child Jesus’s cheek and holds Him close, in a gold icon.
days.look: Look again at the mother’s cheek against her child’s. Whom do you trust to hold what you cannot let go of?
days.license: Unknown artist, 14th century; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain, Google Art Project)

days.file: Saint Paul, Rembrandt van Rijn (and Workshop?), c. 1657.jpg
days.title: The Apostle Paul
days.alt: A bearded Paul rests his head on his hand, quill in the other hand, over his book.
days.look: Look again at Paul’s hand pressed to his tired forehead. What do you most need to hear written down for you today?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Brooklyn Museum - The Last Sermon of Our Lord (Dernier Sermon de Notre-Seigneur) - James Tissot.jpg
days.title: The Last Sermon of Our Lord
days.alt: Jesus stands at the centre of a room, speaking to the apostles gathered around him.
days.look: Look again at the apostles drawn close around him. What would you ask him about the place he has prepared?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain, Brooklyn Museum)
